Write a list of plates to an Excel workbook

write_plate_workbook.Rd

Serializes a list of tabular objects (plate layouts) into an Excel workbook, one sheet per plate. Pure vectors are coerced into one-column data frames using the sheet name (when available) as the column name.

Usage

write_plate_workbook(plates, path, prefix = "Plate_", sheet_namer = NULL)

Arguments

plates

List of plate layouts (data frames, matrices, or vectors).

path

Destination file path for the workbook.

prefix

Prefix used to generate sheet names when none are provided.

sheet_namer

Optional callback `function(plate, index)` returning the sheet name for each plate.

Value

The `path` of the created workbook.
